# CredentialSignInResult

Where a subscription sign-in stands: still waiting for the person (Codex), or done, with the credential.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | [`CredentialSignInStatus`](credential-sign-in-status.md) |  |
| `credential` | [`ModelCredential`](model-credential.md)`\| null` |  |
